title: SHARP 2T-C32GH3000I (reported as SHARP 2K Smart TV-A; Skyworth-built, device beomil, product SW11_SHARP_APEU, MediaTek mt5867), Indonesia
header:
SHARP 2T-C32GH3000I (reported as SHARP 2K Smart TV-A; Skyworth-built, device beomil, product SW11_SHARP_APEU, MediaTek mt5867), Indonesia
Google TV 14 (API 34), build UKN6.260116.061, ~1 GB RAM. Same platform as motorola-swtv-24ae-fhd.
Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx (Google TV).
Setup wizard: com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith (claims HOME).
Live TV app: com.cltv.hybrid; HDMI and tuner inputs: com.mediatek.tvinput.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/sharp-2t-c32gh3000i/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/sharp-2t-c32gh3000i/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Everything is DISABLED for user 0, never uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Port 5555 was closed out of the box; only Wireless debugging was offered, so the first connection
was `adb pair` + `adb connect` + `adb tcpip 5555`.

WARNING: on this set the Wi-Fi network joined during first setup belonged to setupwraith
(`dumpsys wifi | grep -o 'cname=[^ ]*'`). Forget it and re-join it in Settings before disabling
setupwraith, or Android deletes the network and the TV drops off Wi-Fi.

Applied and verified on 2026-10-21: screenshots after each batch, a reboot (nothing came back),
Live TV, HDMI and YouTube/Netflix playback; the real remote's Home, Input, Settings and app buttons
all worked with INPUT_KEY_SERVICE=1 HOME_KEY_SERVICE=1 and settings_key_keycodes 83.
Launcher config: live_tv_package com.cltv.hybrid (also hidden from the grid).
Private DNS works on this set (streams buffered with AdGuard on this ISP, not with Cloudflare).
Voice search for content ("open YouTube to search ...") fails with `provider.OPEN ... UNKNOWN_ERROR`
once launcherx is off (docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md); app commands ("open YouTube") still work. Kept off.

Kept on purpose: com.smartdevice.global.service (global keys, BLE remote, find-my-remote),
com.smartdevice.dailyshortcut (GLOBAL_BUTTON receiver), com.tianci.localmedia (USB media player),
com.google.android.tv.googletvremotepairer (remote pairing), com.smartdevice.factory (never launched),
com.cltv.hybrid, com.mediatek.*, Play Store, Play Services, Gboard, Google TTS, Dolby audio,
com.google.android.katniss (voice, by choice), com.google.android.tv.remote.service (phone remote, by choice),
com.tcl.browser (this is BrowseHere, by choice).

apps.note: "after-sale" service: boot + network receivers, can install APKs
partner config that injects rows into the home screen
Google Play Games, off by choice
Coocaa iCast (AirPlay mirror / DLNA), off by choice
